description: On desktop, the app's own page may read, check, store and delete secrets in the OS keychain through the secret_* commands, and read and add the origins a secret may be sent to (stored under the service halonic-origins), and tokens through the token_* commands: checked names and values only, service halonic (crates/secrets, crates/keychain). The secret_* commands refuse Halonic's own names, tokens included. It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets no secrets. Android gets the Android Keystore later (HAL-1211).
